flags: Dropped current's implication that modern US 25E follows the exact old Wilderness Road alignment: the cache documents tunneling, widening and relocations. Historic corridor and modern highway are distinguished.

FHWA calls the Dixie Highway a Civil War-period route and describes Crockett Tavern as a boyhood home. More specific cache histories establish later road development and a 1950s representation; those descriptions were not reused.
Clinch Mountain page places lowering in the 1980s, while Thorn Hill gives widening work as 1976–1980. Omitted decade pending a primary construction record.
Bean Station displacement rests on Wikipedia; cached family figures contain inconsistent arithmetic and are omitted. No resident quotations or sentiments added beyond the reported relocation dispute.
Crockett moment is shorter because its dedicated cache page is brief. Original versus representation is explicit; no hours or live demonstrations are promised.
